item: Simple mode round 3: first-run start choice, Search paging and language filter, walk fixes
summary: The first-run guide asks where to start, simple view preselected, applied after the guide closes; Search shows more than its first 20 results and filters by language with corpus counts; Today waits while leads are still being built instead of saying nothing stands out; on phones the top bar fits one row; larger tap targets and marks, a focus ring on form fields, spoken names for World and Numbers rows; browser walk of every view in three themes and Arabic at phone and desktop widths; strings x12.
